title: SafeEvolve: Harness-Policy Co-Evolution from Agent Experience for Safety Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2609.02786v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The performance of LLM-based agents is jointly shaped by the base model and the harness used when interacting with the environment. This exposes them to safety risks in both harmful final responses and multi-step execution trajectories. Existing safety alignment mechanisms often rely on either external harness updates or policy optimization, yet applying either paradigm in isolation fails to bridge runtime control with intrinsic safety. We propose SafeEvolve, an experience-driven self-evolving framework for agent safety alignment. SafeEvolve leverages safety experience from completed on-policy trajectories to drive a continual loop of harness-policy co-evolution. On the harness side, SafeEvolve converts trajectory-level safety evidence into bounded, component-level updates across safety prompt and hierarchical skills, yielding auditable and reversible harness artifacts. On the policy side, SafeEvolve follows a two-stage SFT-RL paradigm,

translated_title: SafeEvolve：基于智能体经验的执行框架-策略协同进化安全对齐方法
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体的性能由基础模型和其与环境交互时所使用的执行框架共同决定，这使其在有害的最终回复和多步执行轨迹两个方面都面临安全风险。现有的安全对齐机制通常依赖于外部执行框架更新或策略优化，然而单独应用任一范式都无法将运行时控制与内在安全性有效结合。我们提出了SafeEvolve，一个经验驱动的智能体安全对齐自进化框架。SafeEvolve利用已完成的同策略轨迹中的安全经验来驱动执行框架与策略协同进化的持续循环。在执行框架侧，SafeEvolve将轨迹级的安全证据转化为对安全提示和分层技能的有界、组件级更新，从而产生可审计且可回滚的框架制品。在策略侧，SafeEvolve遵循两阶段的SFT-RL（监督微调-强化学习）范式。
tldr: 提出SafeEvolve框架，利用智能体轨迹中积累的安全经验，驱动执行框架与模型策略的协同进化循环，从而在运行时控制和内在安全两个层面实现对智能体的安全对齐。
en_tdlr: SafeEvolve is an experience-driven self-evolving framework that leverages safety experience from agent trajectories to drive continual harness-policy co-evolution, achieving safety alignment for LLM-based agents at both runtime control and intrinsic policy levels.
